subject: Demo & pilot readiness — ParcelFox integration
messages:
From: Alice Wong <alice@parcelfox.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo request: ParcelFox trading assistant

Hi Ben,

We signed up for Redwood's self-serve last week (team of 8, org: ParcelFox) and want to schedule a live demo to evaluate a pilot for our customer support & routing assistant. Quick context:
- Use case: ingest support tickets, generate summaries, and route to the right specialist; eventual integration with our chat UI.
- Estimated volume: ~250k API calls/month, spikes around product launches (~2.5x), average concurrent requests ~8–12.
- Timeline: hoping to run a 6–8 week pilot starting late July.
- Security: we handle PII and need SOC2 evidence; may require private deployment or VPC.

Would love a 30–45 minute walkthrough focused on latency, batching, and pilot ramp plan. We can share an SSO domain and a small sample dataset if helpful.

Thanks,
Alice Wong
Product Manager, ParcelFox
alice@parcelfox.com

Attachments: security_contact_v2.pdf (see security team contact)
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: Alice Wong <alice@parcelfox.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-07T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: ParcelFox trading assistant

Hi Alice — great to hear from you and congrats on getting started with the self-serve. Happy to run a focused session. A couple quick questions so we tailor the demo and pick the right folks: 

1) Primary success metric for the pilot? (e.g., latency under X ms, deflection rate, accuracy threshold)
2) When you say 250k calls/month — is that mostly short text generation (summaries) or longer multi-turn chat? Any avg token length we should plan for?
3) Do you expect concurrent live traffic in production (users hitting UI) during the pilot, or will it be synthetic/load tests?
4) Any hard compliance constraints (SOC2 Type II required before pilot, or OK after contract)?
5) Preferred timezone/slot for a 30–45m demo (we can do ET mornings or PT afternoons).

I can bring Monica (solutions engineer) to cover integration and batching/quantization suggestions, and Steph from CS to discuss rollout and support. Proposed slots (ET):
- Tue 2028-06-14 10:00–10:45
- Wed 2028-06-15 09:30–10:15
- Thu 2028-06-16 11:00–11:45

If those don't work, share a couple windows and we'll adapt.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Exec – Midmarket
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Alice Wong <alice@parcelfox.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: security@parcelfox.com
Date: 2028-06-07T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: ParcelFox trading assistant

Thanks Ben — answers below and apologies for the detail.

> On 2028-06-07 at 11:05 AM ben.carter@redwood.ai wrote:
> > A couple quick questions so we tailor the demo and pick the right folks:

1) Primary metric: reduce avg handling time and increase deflection — target: sub-150ms median latency for the summary path and >30% deflection on repetitive tickets.
2) Volume profile: primarily short generation (summaries + routing labels). Avg request payload ~350 tokens, responses ~100–150 tokens. 250k/month is our baseline; during launches it could spike to 600k for a few days.
3) Pilot traffic: a mix — some live traffic from a small percent of users (can throttle) + synthetic to validate burst behavior.
4) Compliance: we have SOC2 Type II, but we need to verify data residency options; pilot can start while we complete any legal paperwork.
5) Preferred slots: ET mornings work best (Tue/Thu).

I've attached our security contact doc and a simple traffic estimate spreadsheet so you can validate concurrency assumptions (security_contact_v2.pdf; parcelfox-pilot-estimates.xlsx).

Can you include a short section on recommended batching/batching windows for our profile during the demo? Also want to see Dedicated vs Hosted cost/latency tradeoffs briefly.

Best,
Alice
Product Manager, ParcelFox

Attachments: security_contact_v2.pdf, parcelfox-pilot-estimates.xlsx
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: Alice Wong <alice@parcelfox.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Demo request: ParcelFox trading assistant

Hi Alice — perfect, this is super helpful.

Monica and Steph are looped in — Monica will walk through batching, KV/prefix caching, and quantization options for your 350-token average; Steph will cover pilot support and SLAs.

I've gone ahead and booked Tue 2028-06-14 10:00–10:30 ET for a focused 30m session (Calendly link: https://calendly.com/ben-carter/parcelfox-demo). If that slot doesn't work, pick one from the link and it will update the invite.

Prep for the demo (small asks so we hit the ground running):
- Share SSO domain or IdP metadata if you want SSO shown (send to me or Monica).
- If possible, share a small anonymized sample of ~200 tickets (CSV or JSON) so we can demonstrate summarization quality.
- Confirm whether you need a VPC/on-prem pricing discussion — we can include a short section.

Next internal steps after the demo: Monica will draft a mutual action plan (pilot milestones + success metrics) and we can attach costs for Hosted vs Dedicated runs.

See you Tues — meeting invite coming from my calendar.

Thanks,
